objectives: Build a form for the student ID (SID), the student’s name and the grade.
Use a drop-down list for the grade so everyone picks from the same list.
Save the details and show them on a profile.

mcqs.q: Why is a drop-down list better than a text box for choosing a grade?
a: It prevents typing mistakes and keeps the data consistent
mcqs.why: Fixed choices mean every record uses the same spelling.

mcqs.q: What does it mean to save form data in an app?
a: To store the values so they can be used again later
mcqs.why: Saved data stays available after the user leaves the screen.

mcqs.q: Why should a form check that required fields are filled in before saving?
a: So incomplete data is not stored
mcqs.why: Checking first avoids empty or wrong records.

mcqs.q: What is a student ID (SID) used for?
a: To identify one student's records without mixing them up
mcqs.why: A unique ID tells apart two students who share the same name.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between a field label and the data in the field?
a: The label tells the user what to enter; the data is what they type
The label is saved, the data is not
mcqs.why: Labels guide the user, data is the information the app keeps.
